landing.heroTitle: Candidates apply in the bot, AI tests them, you choose.
landing.heroText: Shortlist keeps vacancies, candidates and applications in one place. A candidate picks a field in the Telegram bot, sends a CV and takes a short test, and you get a ready list with the results.

landing.featuresTitle: A clearer process for every candidate.
landing.featuresIntro: From organizing information to making the final decision, your team has the tools it needs in one place.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Shortlist is a tool that helps teams screen candidates and run their hiring process. This page explains how candidate data is collected, used and stored.
privacy.controllerTitle: Who is responsible for the data
privacy.controllerText: When you apply for a vacancy, your data is reviewed by the HR team of the company that posted it and is kept in that company’s workspace. Shortlist provides the tool to that team.
privacy.dataText: Name, phone number, email, Telegram username and ID, the CV file you upload and the text extracted from it, assessment answers and results, application status, and notes written by HR staff.
privacy.purposeText: Only to review your application for that vacancy and to contact you (by Telegram or email). Your data is not used for advertising.
privacy.aiText: If you consent, CV text and the vacancy requirements are sent to Google Gemini to prepare short summaries, match estimates and assessment questions. AI only assists; the final decision is made by an HR person. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
privacy.storageText: Data is stored in the company’s workspace database, and CV files are kept in cloud storage (Cloudflare R2). The company sets the retention period (shown on the application form); after it ends, rejected and expired applications are anonymised.
privacy.rightsText: You may ask to access, correct or delete your data and may withdraw your consent. Send your request to the HR team of the company that received your application.
